authorization_persistence: After explicit owner approval only: resolve the two roots to absolute external directories in the authorization file, set execution_authorized true, persist the exact owner confirmation and register its SHA in program-status.a3b_v4_execution_authorization. Do not change the frozen protocol/driver/freeze.
requested_scope: Execute only T1-B,C,D,E, three cycles each, sequentially, with the frozen V3 T1-A reference and atol. No T1-A repetition. C invocation cap 750 s and B three single-cycle invocations require explicit approval.
stop_conditions: No valid exact independent owner authorization registered by SHA in program-status
Insufficient accumulated per-config/global budget for the remaining audited horizon
Timeout, resource limit, numerical failure or worker failure; stop campaign, preserve evidence, no automatic retry
